name: 6994-varchat-8blora-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights, and the `base_model_name_or_path` the adapter declares. The Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, GQA 32 query / 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, RoPE llama3 to 131072, bf16, ~16 GB of weights; one LoRA adapter `algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora`, r=64, lora_alpha=16, dropout 0.1, on q_proj k_proj v_proj o_proj gate_proj.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=8 req/s, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. No concurrency cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts centred on 304 tokens with stdev 300, generations on 182 with stdev 150, both clamped 8-1024. Radix cache is off, so every prompt is a real prefill.
purpose: A fact-generation assistant on an adapter-tuned 8B model, serving eight single-turn requests per second from one GPU.
launch:
# host/port/served-model-name are set by the serving layer and are not written here.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# The `lora=` label is the name requests select the adapter by, via the `lora_path` body
# field in scenario.json. Rename it here and every request falls back to the base model.
lora-paths: ["lora=algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora"]

# Required, not tuned: at this commit the server asserts an adapter is served only with the
# radix cache off, and refuses to start otherwise.
disable-radix-cache: true
